rationale: The plan correctly treats the 2x2 as a factorial with ~ condition + time + condition:time in DESeq2, makes the interaction Wald test primary, adds simple effects and an LRT against the additive model, and notes the 8 residual df; time enters as the t0/t1 factor rather than time_hours. QC (VST PCA, distance heatmap, library sizes, explicit outlier flagging) is present but coloring and a shallow-sample policy are not spelled out. The low count filter is only alluded to ('filtered-count summaries') with no threshold or justification, normalization is implicit in DESeq2 rather than stated, no fold change shrinkage (ashr/lfcShrink) is mentioned, and the |log2FC|>1 cutoff is applied post hoc rather than in the test. Enrichment is not strictly warranted but is done defensibly (named WikiPathways version, Wald-stat ranking, full list), lacking a set size window; the report omits package versions and reference level.
